verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack describes unattended access. Community hands-on reports do show the core behavior: one user remotely logs into a Windows PC with no one present after Wake-on-LAN (comm-3). Others discuss TeamViewer storing saved credentials so the client can replay them (comm-6, comm-7, comm-10), which implies credentials configured in advance. Those threads raise security concerns about how the credentials are stored, but they do not contradict the capability. The MSI mass-deployment feature (docs-4) is related but does not itself show unattended access. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of unattended-access setup (e.g., permanent password or account assignment), explicit admin-side pre-configuration of credentials at scale, and independent corroboration beyond indirect user anecdotes.
